detail.longDescription: Sinon has a sandbox concept to group stubs and restore them together. Documentation says that sinon itself is simply the default sandbox. Does this mean that sinon and mySandbox are separate and do not affect each other? Or is sinon the global administrator and also affects all sandboxes? In code: let mySandbox = sinon.createSandbox(); let stub1 = mySandbox.stub(...); let stub2 = sinon.stub(...); sinon.restore(); // does this also restore stub1 in mySandbox?
